structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns
Consolidation of Certain Counties, Cities and Towns

law.text: Each locality which is a party to a consolidation agreement shall cause a copy of the consolidation agreement, or a descriptive summary of the agreement and a reference to the place in the locality where a copy of the agreement may be examined, to be published in its locality at least once a week for four successive weeks in a newspaper having a general circulation in the locality.
